apps.name: Tellio
apps.subtitle: A free player for your own addons and IPTV account.
apps.localizedDescription:
Tellio plays what you bring: your IPTV provider's login or M3U playlist for live TV, and your addons for films and series. On top of that it adds artwork, a proper TV guide, sports with live scores, multiview, reminders, Trakt sync and more.

Tellio doesn't include any channels, films or streams. It only plays what your own IPTV account and addons provide.

versions.localizedDescription:
Tidier addon rows on a match's page

What changed
- Shared code: updated to the addon listing cleanup. Matches in brackets are recognised, row titles and the line under them are tidier, "may be showing it" is stricter, and duplicate rows are combined.
- Match page: addon rows show the tidied title and channel. Long-press lists each source by quality and label.
- Package: the shared code's new Tests folder is excluded, because those checks run on their own in the shared repo.

Fix competition games showing under Today

Ongoing games from a followed competition showed under Today as well as in the competition's row. Now Today only has the followed teams' games; a followed team's own game still shows in both, as intended.
